translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: 1 Pedro
book.title: Pedro Gwenadganse Gebe Garda Narmaksad 1 Pedro

content: Degisoggu, a-ular bela ibmar-iskana-imaked be mimarsun, bela emar-yardaked, wagar-darbo-daed, aimargi nobgued, degi, bela binsa aimargi sunmaked.
Mimmigan-emiskwaa-aidenonikidyob bemar nunis-burbaled-nued-bina sogmar, we-nunis Bab-Dummad-gaya-burbado. Adi agi bemar gatik nasgumai be abonolesmaladgi gumalagar,
ar Bab Dummad dulemar-sabed begi na be itosmalad-ular.
Jesucristo, akwa-nued-neg-ganikidyobidid
Degisoggu, Jesucristose be dagmar, akwa-dulayobidse. Dulemardi istar a-akwa daksamalad, Bab Dummaddi na susa-gusad, degine, we-akwa, akwa-garged-sunnadid, akwa-nuedid.

Amba deyob bemar akwa-duladyob, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-burbaled-soblegedga be gumalad, adi dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-golega bachik-imaklesmalad-nueganyob be gumalagar, adi Bab Dummadga ibmar-ukleged-burbaled-nuegan Bab Dummadga Cristo-nuggi bemar ukmalagar.
A-ulale, Bab-Dummad-Gardagi Cristo akwa-nuedye-sognaidgi sognaibalid:
Ar a-akwa-Jesucristo, agi be bensurmarsoggu, bemargardi we-Cristo ibmar-sunsogedid. Ar dulemar-egi-benmaladdi, Bab-Dummad-Gardagi sognaidba gunonikid:
Sal. 118:22 Deyob Cristo gunonimosundo.
Degine, Bab-Dummad-Gardagi sognaibalid:
Is. 8:14-15 Ar ade uayasurmarsoggu, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burbagi yoledimarsunnad, ar ade bato iduar deyob amarga igar-megisad.
Dulemar-Bab-Dummadgadid

Ar bemardi bato Bab Dummad be-susmalad-dulemar bemar gumalad, Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaidgi dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladga be gumalad, bemar dulemar-swilidikid gumalad, degine, bemar Bab Dummadse sulealid-gumalad. Deyob Bab Dummad bemar-susmalad, adi Bab Dummad ibmar-nued-imakedgi bemar dulemar-baiganga sunmakmalagar, sogmalar, igi bemar neg-sichidgi gudigu, Bab Dummad be-onosmala, e-neg-meegwad-nuedse be-sedamalagar.
Bemar iduardi Bab Dummadgadsurmalanad, emigindi Bab Dummadgadga bemar gunonimalad. Ar iduardi Bab Dummad wilesakwaa bemar-daksasurmalanad, emigindi Bab Dummad wilesakwaa bemar-daknonikisunnad.
Dummagan-urbaligwaa be nanamar

Gwenadgan-sabemalad, an bemargi wilemar, we-napneg bemar-yarsursoggu, be we-napnegginedsurmarsoggu, mer be-san ibmar-iskana-soged-bina be sogmar, ar wede anmar-burba-nued-ebo na urwenanai-guardamalad.

Gwenadgan, dulemar-Bab-Dummad-wichurmalad-abargi nued-nanadii be imakmar, adi bemar dulemar-iskana-gumarye begi sogdidimalad, Bab Dummad amarse ataknonikir, Bab-Dummad-nug odummomalagar, bemar-ibmar-nuegan-imaksad insaarmalar.
Bab-Dummad-ular, bemar bela dulemar-dummagan-nugsalesmalad-urbaligwaa be nanamar, igi rey-dibe, bur-dummadsoggu, a-urbaligwaa bemar nanamar,
ar dummagan-neg-dakmamaid-dibe, Bab Dummad barmialidsoggu, deyob be dakmaloed, dulemar-ibmar-iskana-imakdidimalad-odurdakegar, dulemar-ibmar-nuegan imakdidimalad-e-nugdi odummomaloed.
Ar weyob Bab Dummad na ibmar abemaid: Dulemar-ibmar-wichurmalad istar begi sunmaked, be ibmar-nued-saedba, a-dulemar-obogilegegar.
Ar bemar dule-baid-maiga gudisurmaladyob be nanamar, melle we be-deyob-nanaedi, ibmar-iskana-imakega be ebumar. Suli, degisuli. Be Bab-Dummad-mai-napiragwad-sunnad na be-san oyomar.
Bela dulemargi binsaed-nikaa be damar. Gwenadgan na be sabgumar, Bab Dummad dobegwaa be nanamar. Reygi binsaed-nikaa be damar.
Cristo na e-wilesadgi anmar-odurdaked
Bemar maiga-gudidimalad, be-dummadgi bela nue-binsaed-nikaa be nanamar, unnila dummagan-nuegan daedginbisur, dummagan amba ichakwa-daedgi be binsaed-nikaa dabaloed.
Be wilegedsulinad, dulemar binsa be wiodiir, Bab-Dummad-dobee be nanaed-ular, be wilediid-abin burdiodo. Ar deyob be imakele, we ib-nuedid.
Ar be-iskudiid-ular dulemar sabsur be-odurdakerdi, ¿ar ibi-nued egi be amiosunna, ar bede iskudiid? Ar ibmar-nued-imaked-ular dulemar sabsur be-odurdakerdi, wedi Bab Dummad yeer be-dakdo.
Ar a-ular Bab Dummad anmarse gochad. Ar Cristo amba deyob anmar-ular wilesmogad, anmarga e-wilub na oyosad, adi anmar eba daegar.

Dulemar we-Cristogi istar sunmaknanai-gusgua, edi gwen dulemargi istar sunmaksasulid, dulemar e-wionanai-gusgua, edi gwen dulemar-abin-imaksasulid. Ar deyob gunai-gusgua, Bab-Dummad-igar-inikigwad-imaked, Cristo ase na bela e-igar na uksagusad, ega igar-nudakegar.

Ar a-Cristo-sunnad na e-sangi nakrusgi bioklenai-gusgua, anmar-iskued sesa-gusad, adi anmar iskuedga burgwar gudiguegar, igar-inikigwadginbi nanadii-guegar. A-Cristo bemar-anar naibigusad-ular bemar nugunonisunnad.
Ar bemar sibad-wawaad-yoggus-gudigusmaladyob gudigusanad, emigindi sibad-wawaad-edarbedse na be gannar nonimarsunnad, Cristo, be-san-burba-dakedga maidse.
